data.text: My family taught me to protect this lake, and caring for the village also means keeping its clinic open. Given the confirmed emergency, I commit to harvesting 15 tons this month and donating the $15,000 proceeds. This must be a coordinated exception: all four donations are needed, and we must honor the 30-ton combined cap next month to rebuild the stock. Luke, please confirm you’ll join us at six tons next month. John, can you commit to your share today and that recovery plan?
